name: ASCII
author: Erin Carter
description: A live ASCII terminal — a grid of character cells flickering their values, a diagonal read-out sweep lighting cells bright as it crosses and fading behind, the rest holding a dim amber standby. A console mid-computation, all text.

params.label: Columns
params.effect: How many cells span the grid; low is a chunky readout, high a dense data wall.

params.label: Sweep speed
params.effect: Speed of the diagonal read-out scan; 0 holds it, high races across the grid.

params.label: Flicker
params.effect: How fast cell values re-roll; 0 freezes the symbols, high is a busy scramble.

params.label: Live cells
params.effect: Fraction of cells lit at once; low is a sparse standby, high a fully active panel.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer lights the region around it; 0 ignores the mouse.
